notes: required_exports are undefined ELF imports that RiscRTE must resolve. preferred_exports are currently provided by local compatibility shims and are not required to launch; exporting them from RiscRTE would allow the shims to be removed.

required_exports.name: t5_app_get_api
required_exports.reason: Obtain the RiscRTE application UI/input ABI table.

required_exports.name: t5_storage_get_api
required_exports.reason: Obtain the RiscRTE storage ABI table for ROM reads.

required_exports.name: malloc
required_exports.reason: Allocate ROM image and emulator buffers.

required_exports.name: realloc
required_exports.reason: Resize emulator core buffers; already exported by RiscRTE's libc symbol table.

required_exports.name: memset
required_exports.reason: Emulator core initialization and reset paths.

required_exports.name: memcpy
required_exports.reason: Framebuffer, cartridge RAM, and state copies.

required_exports.name: clock_gettime
required_exports.reason: ELF-local esp_timer_get_time compatibility used by emulator timing and RTC synchronization.

preferred_exports.name: memcmp
preferred_exports.reason: Used by save-state and battery-persist validation; currently implemented locally.

preferred_exports.name: strncmp
preferred_exports.reason: Used by the CrankBoy core; currently implemented locally.

preferred_exports.name: vsnprintf
preferred_exports.reason: Used by CrankBoy diagnostic formatting; currently implemented locally with a reduced formatter.

preferred_exports.name: __udivdi3
preferred_exports.reason: Xtensa compiler helper for unsigned 64-bit division; currently source-owned in the ELF.

preferred_exports.name: __umoddi3
preferred_exports.reason: Xtensa compiler helper for unsigned 64-bit remainder; currently source-owned in the ELF.

preferred_exports.name: __divdi3
preferred_exports.reason: Xtensa compiler helper for signed 64-bit division; currently source-owned in the ELF.

preferred_exports.name: __moddi3
preferred_exports.reason: Xtensa compiler helper for signed 64-bit remainder; currently source-owned in the ELF.
